ns2:section.sectionText: Lecture section. All students must enroll in this lecture section (AL1) and the lab section (AB1--32100) to complete registration in this course. Non-LIS graduate students and undergraduates (juniors or seniors) must have permission of instructor to enroll (mwolske@illinois.edu). A non-waived $70 course fee will be assessed to the student's tuition & fees bill. 4 hours undergraduate and graduate credit.
